entries.en: Where do we get all these parts from anyway? Not like you order 'em.
entries.ro: De unde naiba luăm toate piesele astea? Nu le comanzi, nu?

entries.en: Oh yeah? And what about all those cars that come out here?
entries.ro: A, da? Dar mașinile alea care vin pe aici?

entries.en: Well, I... I thought you was fixin' 'em.
entries.ro: Păi, eu... credeam că le repari.

entries.en: Hm, better get your eyes checked, son. You never noticed how none of them ever leave?
entries.ro: Hm, mai bine-ți verifici ochii, băiete. N-ai observat că niciuna nu pleacă?

entries.en: So all those cars that disappear in Night City...
entries.ro: Deci toate mașinile alea care dispar în Night City...

entries.en: Reappear in the Badlands. In nature, nothing is lost.
entries.ro: Reapar în Badlands. În natură, nimic nu se pierde.

entries.en: Really? And the NCPD don't do a thing?
entries.ro: Serios? Și NCPD nu face nimic?

entries.en: What could they do? Their jurisdiction ends at the city line.
entries.ro: Ce ar putea face? Jurisdicția lor se termină la limita orașului.
